# Buffalo Trace Bottle Drops

> Daily availability tracker for the Buffalo Trace Distillery gift shop in
> Frankfort, Kentucky. Updated every morning (7am EST Mon-Sat, 8am Sun).
> Answers: "What bottles are available at the Buffalo Trace gift shop today?"

Tracked bottles: Blanton's Single Barrel, Weller Antique 107, E.H. Taylor
Small Batch, Eagle Rare 10-Year — plus a dated log of special releases
(Stagg, Weller 12 Year, Weller C.Y.P.B., Weller Single Barrel, E.H. Taylor
Four Grain, Single Oak Rye Bourbon, Sazerac Rye Full Proof).

Includes Bayesian predictions for tomorrow's availability, a day-by-day
calendar since March 2026, and gift shop visit planning info (hours:
Mon-Sat 9am-5pm, Sun 11am-5pm EST; closed Easter, Thanksgiving, Dec 24-25,
Jan 1). Not affiliated with Buffalo Trace Distillery.

## Data

- [Live data, JSON](https://buffalotracebottledrops.com/data.json): today's
  availability, per-bottle stats and predictions, full daily calendar,
  special release log. Refreshed daily.
